title: Nabd
landingTitle: Open the link from your clinic

errorHint: Check your connection and try again.
expiredHint: Ask the clinic to resend it.

consentTitle: A clinic asks to share your records

status_held: Waiting for the clinic to confirm
proxyTitle: Allow {name} to help with your care

proxyScopeRecords: Book visits and see my records

proxyDone: Thank you. {name} can now help with your visits.
